title: agentconsole.v1
description: The bridge protocol between the Mac and the phone: JSON text frames over a WebSocket. A request is {id, op, ...}; the answer is {id, ok: true, data} or {id, ok: false, error}; the Mac also pushes {event, ...}. Binary frames (PHN1, IMG1, WEB1) are described in protocol/README.md. Additive only: every object allows extra fields, and a new field is optional.

Id.description: The request id. The phone sends an integer; the Mac echoes whatever it got, so a string works too. A reply without an id answers a frame the Mac could not read.

ErrorCode.description: Why the Mac refused a request.

SessionControl.description: How the Mac can reach a session: its own pty (console), a background job (job), or not at all (viewOnly).

ChatRole.description: Who wrote a chat message. Tool calls of one step arrive as one tools message.

ChatKind.description: A `!` shell command (text is the command, output what it printed) or the notice that the conversation was compacted. Absent for a normal message.

PromptKind.description: A permission (allow or deny) or a question with options.

SubagentState.description: Whether the subagent is still working.

ImageOrigin.description: Where a chat picture came from.

VizKind.description: Which tab of the viz bundle a spec fills.

type.description: The agent type, for example Explore.

depth.description: 1 for a subagent of the session, 2 for one of its subagents.

PromptQuestion.description: One question of an AskUserQuestion prompt.

Prompt.description: A question or permission a hook on the Mac is waiting on.

Takeover.description: Whether the Mac can take a view-only session over. Only on view-only sessions.

stoppable.description: The original is still running but the Mac can stop it (session.takeover with stopOriginal) and resume.

busy.description: The original is mid-turn: stopping it interrupts the turn.

LastMessage.description: A cheap marker of Claude's newest reply. A new id means a new reply.

text.description: The first lines of the reply.

Limit.description: One limit of the account a session runs on, as a percentage used.

Facts.description: What the chat header shows: the context in use, the model's window and the account's limits.

contextWindow.description: Absent when the window is unknown.

Session.description: One session the Mac knows about.

entrypoint.description: cli, desktop, job, sdk, or the raw entrypoint the session reported.

activity.description: What a working session is doing, for example Editing main.swift.

tool.description: claude, codex or agy. Additive: an older Mac sends none, an older phone ignores it.

Image.description: A picture a chat message refers to. Only this description travels in the chat; the bytes come from chat.image.

ToolStep.description: One tool call inside a tools message.

diff.description: One string per row: "+added", "-removed", " context". Absent when there is no diff.

toolSummary.description: On tools messages: for example Read 2 files, ran 1 shell command.

queued.description: Sent while the agent was working and not yet taken by it.

steps.description: On tools messages: the calls with input, output and diff. Absent when there are none.

output.description: On shell messages: what the command printed.

Command.description: A slash command a session can run.

VizFailure.description: Why a spec could not be built.

FlowCall.description: One tool call in a flow.

FlowTurn.description: One user turn with its calls.

FlowSpec.description: The flow tab: what the session did.

EntityTable.description: A table of the entity diagram.

id.description: Identifier as drawn in the diagram.

EntityLink.description: A relation between tables, in the order of the diagram's lines.

EntitySpec.description: The entity tab: a database schema as a Mermaid ER diagram.

ModelCount.description: How many requests a model served.

VizSpec.description: What the shared viz bundle renders for one tab. Only the field named by kind is filled, unless empty or error says why not.

HelloRequest.description: First message on a connection from a paired phone.

PairRequest.description: First message from a phone that is pairing with the one-time code; the Mac shows its approval sheet.

PingRequest.description: Keep-alive; answered with the Mac's clock.

ChatGetRequest.description: One page of a conversation: the newest limit messages, or the ones before or after a message.

before.description: Id of the oldest message the phone has.

after.description: Id of the newest message the phone has.

VizGetRequest.description: The viz specs of a session.

WebSnapshotRequest.description: A JPEG of a localhost page. The Mac answers with JSON, then a binary WEB1 frame.

url.description: An http(s) URL on localhost or 127.0.0.1; absent: the session's own web URL.

SessionMessageRequest.description: Types a message into a session.

SessionSendNowRequest.description: Interrupts the running turn so the queued message runs next.

bytes.description: Size of the photo, at most 6 MiB.

SessionImageChunkRequest.description: One piece of a photo, in order.

SessionImageEndRequest.description: Finishes a photo upload; its path goes to the session with the caption.

CommandsListRequest.description: The slash commands of a session.

PromptAnswerRequest.description: Answers a permission (allow) or a question (choice or text).

choice.description: For a question: a 1-based option number or an option label; an array with one entry per question.

text.description: A free-text answer to a single question, at most 500 characters.

SessionNewRequest.description: Starts a Claude Code session in a folder inside the Mac's home.

ChatImageRequest.description: A JPEG of a picture in the chat. The Mac answers with JSON, then a binary IMG1 frame.

SessionTakeoverRequest.description: Resumes a view-only session in a terminal the Mac owns.

stopOriginal.description: Stop the original claude process first.

SubscribeRequest.description: Replaces what the Mac pushes to this connection.

sessions.description: Push the session list and prompts.

sessionId.description: Push new chat messages of this session.

lastMessageId.description: The newest message the phone already has, so the ones after it are pushed.

phone.description: Stream the Mac's device window as PHN1 frames.

PairResponse.description: Paired: the token is shown once.

ChatGetResponse.description: A page of messages, oldest first.

hasMore.description: There are older messages (before) or newer ones (after).

reset.description: The after message is gone; replace what the phone has with this page.

suggested.description: The tab to open first: flow, diagram, entity, chart or web.

WebSnapshotResponse.description: A WEB1 binary frame follows with the same request id; then a second answer, SentResponse.

ChatImageResponse.description: An IMG1 binary frame follows with the same request id; then a second answer, SentResponse.

SessionImageBeginResponse.description: The upload id and the piece size to use.

chunkBytes.description: Send pieces of at most this many bytes.

sessionId.description: The new session's id; a pty: id while it is still starting.

stoppedPid.description: The pid of the original claude process that was stopped.

ErrorResponse.description: The Mac refused a request, or could not read the frame (then there is no id).

message.description: Text for the person; the Mac writes Vietnamese.

SessionsEvent.description: The session list changed (also sent once on subscribe).

PromptResolvedEvent.description: A prompt was answered elsewhere or timed out.

ChatEvent.description: New messages in the subscribed session.

OpenEvent.description: The person chose Open on the Mac: the phone should come to the front.

Request.description: A frame the phone sends; the op says which.

Event.description: A frame the Mac pushes without being asked; the event says which.
